arabic text: KARBALA WALON PE YE KAISA MUHARRAM AAYA
english translation text: ALAS! WHAT MUHARRAM HAS BEFALLEN UPON THE PEOPLE OF KARBALA?

arabic text: KHUN TAPAKTA HUWA ABBAS KE PARCHAM AAYA
english translation text: DRENCHED IN BLOOD, ABBAS'S FLAG HAS APPEARED

arabic text: JAISE JAISE MERE GHAZI KA ALAM JUKTAA GAYA
english translation text: AS MY GHAZI (H. ABBAS'S) ALAM KEPT FALLING TO THE GROUND

arabic text: PUSHT MEIN HAZRATE SHABBIR KA BHI KHAM AAAYA
english translation text: HAZRAT SHABBIR'S BACK KEPT BREAKING BECAUSE OF THE SORROW

arabic text: KARBALA DEKHLE ISLAM BACHAANE KE LIYE
english translation text: O KERBALA, SEE HOW ISLAM IS SAVED…

arabic text: SAATH KUMBE KO LIYE WAARIS E ADAM AAYA
english translation text: THE INHERITOR OF ADAM HAS BROUGHT HIS ENTIRE FAMILY

arabic text: ZAALIMON ISKO TO DO BUNDH PILADO PAANI
english translation text: O OPPRESSORS, GIVE HIM TWO SIPS OF WATER AT LEAST

arabic text: AB LABON PAR MERE BESHIR KAA HAI DAM AAYA
english translation text: MY SIX-MONTH OLD (ALI ASGHAR) IS ALMOST DYING OF THIRST

arabic text: SAARE MAUSAM TO GUZAR JAATE HAI AAKAR LAIKIN
english translation text: ALL SEASONS COME AND GO, BUT…

arabic text: BAS HAMESHA KE LIYE MAUSAM E MATAM AAYA
english translation text: THE SEASON OF MAATAM IS HERE TO STAY FOREVER

arabic text: CHAAND RAIHAAN NAZAR AYA MUHARRAM KA IDHAR\nKHUD BA KHUD ASHQ MERI AANKH ME PAIHAM AYA
english translation text: AS I SAW THE MOON OF MUHARRAM,\nMY EYES WERE IMMEDIATELY FILLED WITH TEARS
